title: Unit Event — Chase My Ideal Idol! — Episode4 Special Training, Start!

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! receives an offer to appear at Idol Lovers Festival, the big break for many young idol groups. During rehearsals, Airi is shocked by the performance of another group...

rows.Line: The next day
MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, Haruka, Shizuku, I want you two to teach me how to dance.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You want me to teach you, Airi...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I understand your reasoning, but do you really think we'll be able to help?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Right...
I've always thought that your dancing was more technically sound than mine, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, but to be fair, I've only been learning dance techniques that suit me until now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For example, how to make myself visible to the audience despite not being all that tall.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, you taught me how to do that before!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I feel like my dancing has improved a ton ever since!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it has. I also believe it was worth teaching you that since it's so practical.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But... I can't be the idol I want to become if I keep focusing on those kinds of things.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The idol you want to become...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I want to be an idol who can not only really spread my wings on variety shows...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But one that can also deliver hope by blowing the audience away with my performance.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course, I've been doing what I can until now, and I haven't been settling for second place.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I know that I won't be able to become the idol that I want to be at this rate. ReLight's performance made that all too clear...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I realize now that I won't be able to blow people away with my performances the same way the idols I looked up to when I was little did if I don't change how I do things.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I need to start making a real effort to become the ideal version of myself.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Which is why I need you two to help me...
You're the closest to achieving that goal and you both have something that I don't.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
S-Sorry to interrupt...!
But I'd also like to make the same request!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know I'm just piggybacking on what Airi just said, but I'd also like for you two to teach me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I feel like if I can master the things Airi has taught me along with what I can learn from you guys, then I'll grow even more as an idol...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We can't really say no after being told that, can we?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, we can't.
And I'd like to do what I can for you two!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you both so much!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But don't expect us to go easy on you.
From now on, we're going to refine your techniques every day, starting with the foundations.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Good! I wouldn't have it any other way!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: M-Me neither!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Your arms are still too stiff.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: To put it bluntly, the way you're holding them out makes it look robotic.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Think of your arm as two separate parts. One above your elbow and one below. Try spreading your arms while paying attention to how that joint moves!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Got it...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(This is hard...
We're just raising our arms in the air, but this is a total workout...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Still, this does make us seem more graceful. I mean, this must be why Haruka and Shizuku are able to exude an aura of elegance...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (These are movements where I can apply the techniques I've cultivated so far. I need to make the most of this chance to learn!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's wonderful how your poses feel fun and energetic, but try to use your whole body to exude a more elegant impression.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The position of your limbs is important, but so are their angles. This helps lead the viewer's eye to where you want them to look. Let's try it together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (One subtle motion and I'm looking right where she wants. That was so clean and precise.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Even if I copied her exactly, there's no way the current me would be able to achieve the same result...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But I will be able to as long as I don't give up. So, I've just gotta keep trying...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Nooo! I'm losing balance!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
A-Are you okay, Minori?!
Did I push you too hard?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
N-No, I'm okay!
That was all my fault!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, please! Could we try that again?
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay.
Why don't we call things here for today?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We'll try to come up with different exercises for tomorrow. For now, nice work, you two.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-Thank you!!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I didn't think there were this many muscles I never used before.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
S-Same here...
My body's gonna be aching all over tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You two are drenched in sweat. Why don't you go grab a couple of towels? I'll mix up some protein for you two in the meantime.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, really?!
You're even helping us with muscle building? Thank you so much, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
A recovery drink does sound nice.
Alright, let's go grab those towels...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Airi and Minori worked so hard today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, also...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You seem really happy, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's because I am! When Airi asked me to teach her how to dance, I honestly wasn't sure if I'd be able to help her...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I feel really happy right now because my skills and experiences are benefitting her and Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Right...
Teaching them has also been a nice learning experience, so I'm glad we decided to do this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But that's not all...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I realize now that I won't be able to blow people away with my performances the same way the idols I looked up to when I was little did if I don't change how I do things.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I need to start making a real effort to become the ideal version of myself.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Which is why I need you two to help me...
You're the closest to achieving that goal and you both have something that I don't.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Airi was completely serious...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (ReLight's performance was also an eye-opener for me, but what compelled me to become a better idol was actually...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I need to learn from their example.
